description: Lane CK: load Google Analytics only after visitor consent, with a consent banner and a footer control to change the choice.

userStories.title: Add the consent banner and gate Google Analytics
acceptanceCriteria: npm test runs the consent tests with node --test and exits 0; the tests cover no choice, reject, and accept.
Local production build, no choice: the banner shows, no googletagmanager.com request, no _ga cookie.
After reject and reload: no googletagmanager.com request, no _ga cookie.
After accept: the Google Analytics script loads and the _ga cookie exists.
The footer Cookie settings control opens the banner again.
Agent-browser screenshots of the banner, accepted, and rejected states are in .agro/tasks/ga-consent-banner/evidence/.
